name: Cottage cheese
description: Loose fresh curds, barely cultured — the plainest cheese there is.

ayurveda.note: Fresh unsoured curd stays shita — it is souring that turns dairy ushna.

unani.note: Thanda-tar, the same reading as paneer.

histamine.note: Fresh and lightly cultured; among the safer cheeses for a reactive day.

guna.note: Fresh dairy is sattvic; the reading changes once it sours or ages.
